website_check_note: Tried jrsbarbershop.com (live, but a DIFFERENT Jr's Barbershop in San Marcos/North County San Diego, CA), jrsbarbershopgainesville.com (does not resolve), jrbarbershop.com (live, Wix site, unrelated business), jrsbarbershopgainesville.net / jrsbarbershop.net (do not resolve). WebSearch for the business name + Gainesville turns up only the Booksy listing, no owned domain. Not own site.
email_note: Deep search: Booksy page HTML (only help.us@booksy.com, Booksy support, found), Instagram bio via WebFetch (429 rate limited on 2 attempts), Facebook page facebook.com/jrs.barbershop.1/about (login-walled, no data), Google search for FB/IG bio content (no snippet with contact info). No public email found.
phone_note: Booksy page embeds a Booksy call-masking/proxy number (+1 206-735-3553, tagged internally as call/display forwarding ids), not a permanent published business line, so not used as the business phone. No other public phone found.
rating_source: Booksy JSON-LD aggregateRating (ratingValue 4.959 rounds to 5.0, reviewCount 98), fetched live from the Booksy listing page; independent Google rating page not found for this specific listing.
owner_staff_confirmed: Joseph Luis Rivera ("Barber Joe" per shop logo), confirmed via visible Florida barber license certificate in bk-1.jpg, matches staff name Joseph in dossier.
photo_curation_note: Original bk-3..bk-8 downloaded by the dossier were 100x100 Booksy review thumbnails (too small for a premium build). Recovered full-resolution originals from the same Booksy CDN by dropping the ?size= query param and re-saved as bk-3..bk-7 (max 1300px). bk-8 (dark low-quality candid) and bk-9 (broken avatar placeholder) were not used. bk-1 (owner selfie) used only as a small avatar in the Experience section, never as a gallery tile.
